description: Function declarations for the ClearFrame crew playbooks. Import these into Agent Builder; each playbook's `tools:` list names the subset it may call.

function_declarations.name: parallel_search
function_declarations.description: T0 recon. Run keyword web searches and get back cited excerpts. Cheap and wide — use it first, and use it to check someone else's answer independently.

objective.description: What you are trying to establish, in one sentence

function_declarations.name: parallel_extract
function_declarations.description: Fetch the full text of specific pages you have already found, as clean markdown. Use it on the two most authoritative results, not on everything.

objective.description: What you are looking for in these pages

function_declarations.name: parallel_task
function_declarations.description: Run one structured research task against your specialist's output schema. This is where facts come from: the result is schema-shaped, citation-backed, and is the only thing that can become a finding. Name the entity and the specific fact sought in the objective — a vague objective returns uncited prose.

objective.description: The research task. Name the work, the entities found in recon, and the exact question — e.g. 'Establish the current controller of the composition and the owner of the master for X as used in Y'

function_declarations.name: submit_finding
function_declarations.description: Commit a draft produced by parallel_task to the ledger. A draft with no citations cannot be committed. Say in `note` what the draft establishes and what it does not.

note.description: What this finding establishes, and what remains open

function_declarations.name: get_item_context
function_declarations.description: Read the item under investigation and everything already established about it, including prior findings and any challenges filed against them.

item_id.description: Defaults to the item you were dispatched to

function_declarations.name: verify_pass
function_declarations.description: Pass a finding through to risk scoring. Use it when the claim is supported by current, authoritative, internally consistent sources.

rationale.description: Why it survives: which source carries the claim

function_declarations.name: file_challenge
function_declarations.description: Reject a finding and send it back for re-research. A challenge must cite the ground: a source that is stale, weaker than the claim needs, or contradicts it. You may not reject on suspicion alone — if you cannot cite the doubt, pass it.

rationale.description: The specific defect, naming the offending source

citation_urls.description: URLs that evidence the ground; at least one

function_declarations.name: search_clearance_guidance
function_declarations.description: Retrieve passages from the grounding corpora — E&O underwriting guidance and network clearance handbooks. Every risk judgement must rest on a retrieved passage, quoted by its reference.

query.description: What guidance you need, e.g. 'background artwork de minimis'

function_declarations.name: submit_assessment
function_declarations.description: Record the risk state for the item, with mitigations. GREEN needs no mitigation; AMBER and RED need two or three, each with a cost delta and a production impact. Every output is research and drafting for a human, never a legal conclusion.

rationale.description: Why this state, referencing the findings and the guidance

grounding_refs.description: References to the handbook passages you relied on

function_declarations.name: findall_rights_holders
function_declarations.description: Discover the entities that actually control a catalog or collection and how their licensing desk is reached. Give explicit match conditions — vague objectives return plausible companies rather than the right ones.

objective.description: e.g. 'Find licensing entities controlling the X catalog'

function_declarations.name: draft_outreach
function_declarations.description: Draft a licence inquiry for counsel to approve. Drafting is all you can do: there is no send capability in this system, only a queue behind the counsel gate.

holder_name.description: Rights holder the inquiry is addressed to

to_name.description: Named contact, if one was discovered

to_email.description: Contact email, only if it came from a cited source

contact_source_url.description: Where the contact detail was found

body.description: The inquiry: what is used, where, for how long, and the ask

function_declarations.name: record_items
function_declarations.description: Emit the clearable elements you extracted. Extraction only — no rights conclusions, no ownership guesses, no risk language.
